intent.text: Revised motion (indep), incorporating the convergence in r3–r4. Recommend: (1) The vsect plan draft is checked by one independent reviewer from a model family other than the author's. The reviewer receives the draft and its claims, not the author's reasoning. (2) The review marks defects and unverified claims against the draft in place. It carries no score or approval and stays attached to the plan. Claims the author states as verified that the reviewer could not check are recorded as unverified, not escalated. (3) The author revises or declines each finding in writing; the author does not self-certify. A material fix is re-checked by the same reviewer or by one from a third family. (4) A council is convened only after review, and only to decide a named estate choice that the revised plan still contains (a policy or a risk the estate will live with). It is not convened to approve or grade the draft. Any council used as a check must include a family other than the author's; if it does not, its agreement is coherence, not verification. Caveat: the 43% vs 116-of-116 figure is an estate base rate for finished landings, not evidence that this plan is defective.
